markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the party official resigns or announces their resignation.

markets.title: Will the Leader of the Green Party of England and Wales resign before Nov 1, 2026?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Katie Zacharia is announced or appointed to another administration role.
markets.rules_primary: If Katie Zacharia is announced or appointed as the holder of an administration role other than White House Press Secretary for President Trump before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Any position in the Trump administration other than White House Press Secretary counts, including a White House aide, advisor, envoy or spokesperson role, or a nomination, appointment or announcement to a role in a federal department or agency. Her service as White House Press Secretary, or any duty performed as part of that role, does not count.
markets.title: Will Katie Zacharia take another Trump administration role before Nov 1, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If the United States has agreed to, signed, or accepted a new Iran-US nuclear deal before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An agreement also made with other countries (i.e. multilaterally) is still encompassed if the United States participates. "A new Iran-US nuclear deal" means a formal written agreement signed by authorized representatives of both the United States and Iran that (1) imposes verifiable restrictions on Iran's nuclear program, including limits on uranium enrichment, centrifuge numbers, or nuclear facility operations, AND (2) provides for the lifting, suspension, or modification of at least one US economic sanction on Iran in exchange for Iran's nuclear commitments.

Clarification (04/19/26): The Agreement Long rulebook variable defines the nature of the qualifying instrument: it must be a formal written agreement signed by authorized representatives of both governments. It does not impose a precondition that the signing itself must occur before resolution. Because the Payout Criterion is satisfied if the United States has "agreed to, signed, or accepted" such an instrument, both governments publicly and officially agreeing to the terms of what will be a qualifying written agreement is sufficient to resolve the market to Yes, even if the formal signing has not yet taken place.

Clarification (06/02/26): A qualifying instrument must impose "verifiable restrictions on Iran's nuclear program." A restriction is "verifiable" only where it establishes a concrete, objectively ascertainable standard (a defined limit, prohibition, quantity, or monitoring provision) against which compliance could in principle be confirmed; a general expression of intent that fixes no such standard is not considered “verifiable” for the purposes of this event. Accordingly, a bare pledge not to develop or pursue nuclear weapons, unaccompanied by any concrete limit on Iran's nuclear materials, activities, or facilities, does not on its own satisfy criterion (1). Conversely, a commitment to completely 'stop' or ‘suspend’ a specific nuclear activity (such as uranium enrichment) establishes a concrete prohibition (an implicit limit of zero) and qualifies as a restriction, whereas a vague promise to 'reduce' activities without a defined metric or monitoring mechanism does not. The enumerated examples (limits on uranium enrichment, centrifuge numbers, or nuclear facility operations) are illustrative and not exhaustive: a formal, verifiable commitment to remove, transfer, or cap Iran's stock of enriched uranium, confirmable by the receiving state or an oversight body, is a restriction on Iran's nuclear program and satisfies criterion (1). In every case, criterion (2) must independently be met.

Clarification (06/17/26): To clarify, the U.S.–Iran memorandum of understanding reportedly now in effect does not satisfy criterion (1) of the definition of a "new Iran-US nuclear deal," and this market will therefore not resolve to Yes on the basis of that instrument at this time. The memorandum provides for the existing state of Iran's nuclear program to be maintained pending a subsequent agreement, and defers the disposition of Iran's stockpile of enriched uranium to a mechanism to be mutually agreed in that subsequent agreement. That it states a minimum methodology for that future mechanism — down-blending on site under IAEA supervision — constrains the form of a mechanism yet to be agreed, but specifies no quantity, enrichment level, or completion deadline for the down-blending. An instrument that provides for maintaining Iran's nuclear program at an unspecified status quo, or that defers its substantive nuclear commitments to a subsequent agreement, does not by itself establish the concrete, objectively ascertainable standard that a "verifiable" restriction requires.

markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has physically travelled to and been present within the geographic boundaries of Wisconsin on or after Oct 1, 2026 and before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.

markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has taken any presidential actions on Oct 31, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Nov 1, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The market solely resolves to the publication date visibly displayed on the "Presidential Actions" tab at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET the following day.

Payout criteria

The actions may include proclamations, executive orders, nominations & appointments, and memoranda.
Any item listed on the page counts, regardless of its legal effect.

Examples (for Jan 10, 2026):

Executive Order with a Jan 7 signing date is released with a Jan 10 publication date → resolves Yes
Proclamation e-mailed to White House Press Pool but not uploaded by 10:00 AM next day → resolves No
Proclamation is released Jan 10 with a backdated Jan 9 publication date → resolves No
Bill signed into law and shows up on "Briefings & Statements" instead of "Presidential Actions" → resolves No

markets.rules_primary: If Kenya has agreed to, signed, or accepted a critical minerals agreement with the United States before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An agreement also made with other countries (i.e. multilaterally) is still encompassed if Kenya participates. A qualifying agreement is a written agreement, memorandum of understanding, framework, or similar instrument between the government of Kenya and the government of the United States, including any U.S. federal department or agency, that is expressly described in its text or in either government's official announcement as concerning critical minerals or rare earth elements, including their exploration, mining, processing, refining, supply, purchase, or financing.

A preliminary agreement, agreement in principle, or memorandum of understanding qualifies; ratification, entry into force, and implementation are not required. Both governments publicly and officially agreeing to the terms of such an instrument is sufficient even if formal signing has not yet taken place.

An agreement that also covers other subjects qualifies if it includes such critical minerals terms. A contract, license, or project award between either government and a private company, without both governments as parties, does NOT qualify. Statements that negotiations are advanced or ongoing do NOT qualify. Joining, endorsing, or signing a declaration, communique, statement of principles, or membership in a multi-country forum or partnership, such as the Forum on Resource Geostrategic Engagement or the Minerals Security Partnership, does NOT qualify unless the instrument sets out critical minerals commitments specifically between Kenya and the United States. A grant, loan, financing commitment, technical-assistance, geological-survey, or data-sharing agreement for a single study or project does NOT qualify unless either government officially describes it as a critical minerals agreement, framework, or partnership between Kenya and the United States.
markets.title: Will Kenya and the US reach a critical minerals deal before Nov 1, 2026?

An announcement that the Miguel Díaz-Canel will leave the office within the next year is also encompassed by the Payout Criterion. If Miguel Díaz-Canel leaves solely because they have died, the associated market will resolve and the Exchange will determine the payouts to the holders of long and short positions based upon the last traded price (prior to the death). If a last traded price is not available or is not logically consistent, or if the Exchange determines at its sole discretion that the last traded prices prior to death do not represent a fair settlement value, the Outcome Review Committee will be responsible for making a binding determination of fair allocation.

markets.rules_secondary: A qualifying meeting must satisfy the following: both persons must be present (physically or virtually, as specified) and engage in communication or interaction—mere presence in the same location without interaction does not constitute a meeting unless otherwise specified. The meeting must be confirmed by at least one Source Agency through official statement, press release, credible media report, or other documented evidence. The meeting must occur at any point during the time period; for meetings that span across the boundary of the time period, any portion of the meeting occurring within the time period is sufficient. Coincidental encounters without purposeful engagement (e.g., passing in a hallway without acknowledgment) do not count. Communication via intermediaries, written letters, or social media do not count unless specified.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of distinct US states Donald Trump has visited (per VISITAREA rules) is at least 28 in Oct 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
VISITAREA contract: https://kalshi-public-docs.s3.amazonaws.com/contractterms/VISITAREA.pdf

The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.
